verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the quickstart, which says you can make a first API call in under a minute and explore text generation, function calling, agents and more. That implies runnable code examples, but nothing shows an interactive reference. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is also no machine-readable spec that an interactive explorer could be built from. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference explorer, in-browser runnable "try it" examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
